svg.title: Build a deployment-readiness decision
svg.desc: Five ordered evidence stages: qualified hardware configuration, Azure and local identity, network dependencies, versioned validation, and reviewed acceptance. Readiness is dated evidence, not simply a green check.

text.tspan: Reading order: 1 to 5. Arrows assemble evidence; they do not automate deployment.
OEM firmware, drivers and Solution Builder Extension (SBE)
Readiness is dated evidence — not just a green check.
Record the build, site, owners and review date.
